listing.summary: A meticulously curated Solar System based on Sol. Uses real data based on NASA and other sources, such as rotation, orbitSpeed, orbitDays, tilt, pitch, size, descriptions etc etc. Created as best as i could for with Starsector's scales, speeds, and modifiers.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a realistic solar system with 60 entities based on NASA data.

description:
new!

Update:
I am uploading a DEV test version of the Sol system written from scratch in 100% Java. Lots of new features with 0 Dependencies!
Content and features are based on other mods installed. Feedback is appreciated.
Be sure to check lunalib options, more settings will be exposed.
Incompatible with the CSS version above!

A meticulously curated Solar System based on Sol.
Uses real data based on NASA and other sources, such as rotation, orbitSpeed, orbitDays, tilt, pitch, size, descriptions etc etc.
Created as best as i could for with Starsector's scales, speeds, and modifiers.
Also serves as an example of what you can do with the fantastic mod of Customizable Star Systems.

Features:
Spoiler
[REDACTED] Go Explore! There are about 60 Entities in this system. Lots of things to find. Maybe way out there.
If you need to spawn the system or a new one mid game you can use the console command SpawnCustomStarSystems css_Sol

Java Version - NONE!
Content scales based on the mods you have installed

Vanilla Version - only CSS mod required

Kaleidoscope
Wide Horizons

Planned Features:
Add custom population glow per stage to all bodies.
Custom settings for toggling mods conditions via a settings file.
Offer a standalone jar file with no dependencies.
New Faction with lore and quests?

Notes:Spoiler
-If you need to spawn a system mid save you can use a console command:spawnCustomStarSystems Sol_Modded or spawnCustomStarSystems Sol_Vanilla

-Be aware that depending on RNG your Sol system could spawn with Meteor Showers, Minefields, Artillery Stations, Special Modded Cryosleepers etc when using other mods that add Procgen entities to systems.
-I have several versions of this system. Vanilla, non-modded, stacked, extreme difficulty, procgen conditions etc. Including the first iteration with realish/vanilla conditions.
Will upload if requested. This is the one i am currently testing. Feel free to edit to your hearts desire. If you need help with this or making your own, just ask.
(can change with setLocation=Any positive whole number n -> n-th closest constellation to Core Worlds, where n is any number greater than 0 (0 will be random)).
-Some moons require a high burn speed in order to catch them.. This isn't an issue for NPC fleets.

CreditsSpoiler
Tranquility (css), JamesTripleQ (texture), and Taiwendo (music). As well as authors of the above mods. Also to all the peeps who were interested in the project and asked to share.

aiDescription: Adds a meticulously curated Solar System based on Sol using real data for rotation, orbit speed, and size. It serves as an example of what can be done with Customizable Star Systems. The content scales based on other installed mods.
saveCompatibilityText: If you need to spawn the system or a new one mid game you can use the console command SpawnCustomStarSystems css_Sol [close]
